description_en: Retrieves the details of a synchronization task in a user pool
description_zh: 获取用户池同步任务信息
name: GetUserPoolSyncJob

parameters.help_en: The name of the user pool
parameters.name: user_pool_name

parameters.help_en: The ID of the synchronization task
parameters.name: synchronization_job_id

EndTime.description_en: The end time of the synchronization

IdentityProviderType.description_en: The type of the identity provider

Created.description_en: The statistics of created users in JSON format, including the following four fields: total (total count), success (success count), failed (failure count), and skipped (skipped count)
Created.description_zh: 新建用户统计，JSON 格式，包含 total（总数）、success（成功数）、failed（失败数）、skipped（跳过数）四个字段

Deleted.description_en: The statistics of deleted users in JSON format, including the following four fields: total (total count), success (success count), failed (failure count), and skipped (skipped count)
Deleted.description_zh: 删除用户统计，JSON 格式，包含 total（总数）、success（成功数）、failed（失败数）、skipped（跳过数）四个字段

Same.description_en: The statistics of unchanged users in JSON format, including the following four fields: total (total count), success (success count), failed (failure count), and skipped (skipped count)
Same.description_zh: 无变化用户统计，JSON 格式，包含 total（总数）、success（成功数）、failed（失败数）、skipped（跳过数）四个字段

Updated.description_en: The statistics of updated users in JSON format, including the following four fields: total (total count), success (success count), failed (failure count), and skipped (skipped count)
Updated.description_zh: 更新用户统计，JSON 格式，包含 total（总数）、success（成功数）、failed（失败数）、skipped（跳过数）四个字段

StartTime.description_en: The start time of the synchronization

Status.description_en:
The status of the synchronization task. Valid values:

Pending: The initial state.

Running: The task is running.

Failed: The task failed.

PartialSuccess: The task partially succeeded.

Success: The task succeeded
Status.description_zh:
同步任务状态，取值可选范围：

Pending：初始状态

Running：运行中

Failed：失败

PartialSuccess：部分成功

Success：成功

SynchronizationJobId.description_en: The ID of the synchronization task

TriggerType.description_en: The trigger type of the synchronization task. Valid values: Manual (manually triggered). Only manual triggering is supported
TriggerType.description_zh: 同步任务的触发类型。取值：Manual（手动触发）。当前仅支持手动触发
